problem: Questions about summit visibility and cloudy conditions in Brisas route between weather forecasting and the ecotourism policy of whether the excursion to Valle de las Tumbas proceeds when cloudy.
suggestion: weather_volcano keeps meteorology, cloud patterns, and visibility forecast questions. Activities keeps the specific ecotourism policy that the tour to Valle de las Tumbas is still conducted even if the summit is shrouded in clouds.

problem: Visitors asking where they can touch snow or walk to glacier edges are routed to ecological explanations of glacier retreat in flora_ecosystems.
suggestion: flora_ecosystems keeps the biological and glaciological explanations of ice loss. Activities answers tourist queries on where access to snow/glacier edge is permitted (Santa Isabel) and guide requirements.

problem: Questions about pack animals or horses confuse passenger riding (banned) with luggage transport services provided by registered muleteers.
suggestion: rules and activities keep the tourist horse riding prohibition under Resolucion 207. Services keeps authorized cargo/luggage mule service requirements.

problem: Camping inquiries route between rules (general camping prohibition and sanctions), services (cabins and amenities at El Cisne), and activities (authorized transitory camping spots in Resolucion 207).
suggestion: Keep rules focused on infractions, services on facility infrastructure, and activities on designated ecotourism overnight camping locations.

problem: Trail descriptions in activities overlap with sector access routes in access.
suggestion: access keeps transportation, vehicular road directions, and travel distances to park gates. Activities keeps trail descriptions, scenery, and hiking experiences inside the protected area.
